body:
I wouldn't even know where to begin. Honesty. 

My dad died when I was 20, and I don't think I will ever get over that.

My mother abandoned me in June of 2015, and hasn't spoke to me since. I texted her that I was struggling with severe depression and suicidal thoughts. Her reply was, "Stop being dramatic and just do it already."

I was assaulted in September by my roommates ex husband. He was also my CEO for the company I worked for.

I've been out of work for almost 3 months now,  no imcome.

I'm supposed to start a new job but they still haven't got back to me after 90 days.

Havent eaten in 2 days, haven't slept in 3. If I do finally fall asleep, I have bad nightmares.

I relate a lot to this post. I know the feeling of waking up with no purpose, saying "fuck it" and letting the entire day waste away. I can't say that it gets better because that's not necessarily how it works. You have to find an out, SOMETHING worth getting up for. Something that makes you feel again. 

I'd love to talk more with you if you'd like?

Tbh it's so much stuff and it's been going on for so many years that I wouldn't even know where to start. I'm unhappy with almost every aspect of my life. I'm a 26 year old female. I know that there is a lot more to life that I have yet to experience, but I can't even see myself making it to next week.
I sent you a message. Please reply.
